execution.label: Generate a PSD background and set its text
execution.description: Generate an image with Firefly from a prompt, place it as the PSD's background layer (filling the canvas), set the headline and subhead text layers, and return hosted PNG and PSD renditions.

psdPath.description: Absolute path to the template PSD on this machine.

prompt.description: What Firefly should generate for the background.

headline.description: New text for the headline layer; omit to keep the PSD's text.

subhead.description: New text for the subhead layer; omit to keep the PSD's text.

backgroundLayer.description: Name of the layer to replace. Default: Background.

headlineLayer.description: Name of the headline text layer. Default: Headline.

subheadLayer.description: Name of the subhead text layer. Default: Subhead.

background.description: Firefly result: outputs[0].image.url is the generated image.

banner.description: Photoshop result: hosted PNG and PSD output URLs.

steps.label: Upload the template and generate the background at the same time

branches.label: Upload the PSD and sign a read URL

steps.label: Replace the background and set the text

layers.$expr: (state) => { const layers = [{ name: state.backgroundLayer || 'Background', type: 'layer', operation: { type: 'edit' }, image: { source: { url: state.background.outputs[0].image.url } }, transformMode: 'fill' }]; const text = (name, content) => { if (typeof content === 'string' && content.length > 0) layers.push({ name, type: 'text_layer', operation: { type: 'edit' }, text: { content } }); }; text(state.headlineLayer || 'Headline', state.headline); text(state.subheadLayer || 'Subhead', state.subhead); return layers; }
